svg.title: VehicleMultiECUFeatureExecution [closedLoopIntegration]
svg.desc: Feature Platform의 Desired State를 여러 차량 제어기에 전달하고 Local Guard, 실제 적용 상태, 집계, 불일치 분류 및 보정 후 재평가까지 닫힌 루프로 나타낸 다중 제어기 통합 내부 블록도
svg.text: Feature ID · BOM · Topology · signed policy
PKI · campaign · OTA/CCS rail · vehicle identity
COMPARE → MATCH / PENDING / DENIED / PARTIAL / STALE / TIMEOUT → COMMIT / HOLD / RETRY / POLICY-ROLLBACK / KILL → RE-EVALUATE
VSIDL/AIDL · vsock · SOME/IP · Ethernet · CAN · AUTOSAR RTE | Decision/Intent ↓ · Guard/ApplyAck/ActualState/Reason ↑
Command accepted or service started does not mean Feature Effective. Every required node must return correlated, fresh Local Guard and Actual State evidence.
Mismatch, denial, stale evidence or timeout keeps the state PENDING / DEGRADED and invokes the approved retry, hold, policy rollback, kill or incident path.
AAOS Orchestrator does not coordinate all ECUs; real-time control and final safety authority remain in each OEM control application.
FP-AAOS-SYSML-04 · v1.5 · Multi-ECU closed-loop IBD · Full / Native / Guard-Lite / Gateway profiles
